en: Cancellation requested; waiting for a safe stop and cleanup
Wait for active tasks before checking recovery
Review the current state below. The interrupted operation has not been repeated.
A password change cannot be verified from stored credentials. Sign in or set a new password through Users.
Open home-folder settings. Recover an existing transfer before attempting another move; destination copies may have been retained.
Module transactions are recovered during agent startup. Review the installed version and enablement before installing again; upload credentials are not retained in the task.
Network watchdogs handle pending rollbacks. Review current connectivity and any pending confirmation in Network before applying a fresh configuration.
Do not restart package installation blindly. Review package status and refresh the update list; incomplete packages require repair before another upgrade.
Power actions are never replayed automatically. System availability alone does not prove whether the previous reboot completed.
Compare source and destination before retrying. A partial copy may exist; do not delete either automatically. Presence or size alone does not prove a complete copy.
Check array members and maintenance progress. Use the array pause/resume controls for an existing operation; do not recreate or reformat the array.
Inspect the actual partition/filesystem state. Formatting and resizing cannot be safely rolled back by rerunning the command. Back up available data before repair.
Cancelled at a safe point; inspect the result before starting another operation
